decision.title: Header review findings (task 0.8)
decision.summary: The Phase 0 header review adds sxml_name_test wildcards, sxml_name_pool_find_namespace_uri, sxml_sequence_test_emptiness and an arena tree duplicate attribute policy, and moves argument coercion to the evaluator.

body.p: . Changes made by the Phase 0 review agent ():

item.p: types.h: node tests carry an sxml_name_test (any name, expanded name, prefix:*/Q{uri}*, *:local), because XPath 4.0 element and attribute tests take a NameTestUnion with wildcards (element(p:*)); the same struct serves path steps.
name.h: sxml_name_pool_find_namespace_uri, so a name from untrusted input can be looked up without interning its namespace URI.

xdm.h: sxml_sequence_test_emptiness replaces a bool predicate that swallowed generator errors (fn:empty on a lazy sequence must raise them); sxml_function_item_call does not coerce arguments, the evaluator does (coercion needs casting and function coercion); the borrowed-output verbs are get, describe, find and iterator next; iterator sizes are ABI.

tree.h: sxml_duplicate_attribute_policy in the arena tree configuration (XQuery rejects with XQDY0025, XSLT 4.0 section 5.7.1 replaces); builder errors use XQuery codes and XSLT rewrites them; the event order is the caller's contract (XQTY0024 and XTDE0410 are checked by the evaluators, well-formedness by the XML parser).
